invariants.name: INV01_expectations_match
invariants.detail: Every scenario's declared expectation (gate state, outcome, dispositions) is observed — the scenario exercised the intended condition.

invariants.name: INV02_served_turns_have_verifier_approval_commit_disposition
invariants.detail: Every served turn: verification passed+accepted, approval approved, commit disposition accepted (observable, not inferred).

invariants.name: INV04_no_unauthorized_commit
invariants.detail: No commit is accepted without a passing verifier verdict AND approved HITL on that attempt.

invariants.name: INV05_no_unsafe_evidence_promotion
invariants.detail: Policy refs subset of gate-valid IDs; non-VALID gate never consumes a strategy or selects non-baseline; VALID gate selects one.

invariants.name: INV06_no_arm_state_leakage
invariants.detail: Baseline records carry no V4 policy stage/engine; V4 records carry exactly the policy stage of their own arm.

invariants.name: INV07_policy_visible_evidence_and_strategy_match_trace
invariants.detail: Gate-valid IDs, judge-filter visible IDs, policy-visible before/after, bundle hash and consumed strategy all agree across bundle, policy decision and serving attempts.

invariants.name: INV08_commit_dispositions_explicit_with_state_hashes
invariants.detail: Every attempt carries an explicit disposition (accepted/rejected/not_attempted) with reason; accepted/rejected commits carry consistent before/after state hashes; no-op and rejected (not_committed) states are labeled explicitly — never inferred.

invariants.name: INV09_fallback_and_noop_events_explicit
invariants.detail: Fallback turns record an explicit fallback reason; no-op commits are recorded explicitly and consistently.

invariants.name: INV10_no_inference_filled_commit_metadata
invariants.detail: No attempt leaves commit metadata as the NOT_VERIFIABLE sentinel — nothing is left for downstream inference.

invariants.name: INV11_response_differences_survive_decorative_marker_removal
invariants.detail: First line (prompt/echo decoration) stripped from baseline and supported-evidence responses; remaining content must differ.

invariants.name: INV12_persistence_restart_continuity
invariants.detail: After restart: session log resumes (SESSION_RESUME), turn count continues, pinned host identity and promoted host facts persist, and the turn serves with full dispositions.

invariants.name: INV13_rejected_update_rolled_back_and_persisted
invariants.detail: Rejected update: fiction graph restored (before==after), host store restored AND persisted to disk, generator state untouched, fallback commit accepted.

invariants.name: INV14_no_unserved_state_mutation_and_errors_explicit
invariants.detail: A turn that does not serve records an explicit error and never leaves an accepted commit behind.
